scope_notes: Reused shared ApiResponse/PagedResult/PageMeta, CurrentUserContext and GlobalExceptionHandler; no parallel envelope, auth, pagination or error infrastructure was introduced.
InboxController has explicit PLATFORM_ADMIN/HOST_ADMIN method security and InboxReadService repeats self-scope validation, binding user and null-safe tenant from CurrentUser only.
V72 stores opaque UUID snapshots with recipient, tenant, expiry and upper sequence; read queries never accept a client recipient or tenant override.
InboxReadStore uses recipient-stream locking for snapshot capture, unread counts, single-read and mark-all; anchored pages exclude later arrivals while live read_at membership remains observable.
Read-all uses an optional server-issued snapshot only after recipient ownership and expiry validation; delivery/read state remains transactionally serialized.

Typed target type/public ID is returned as data; no arbitrary redirect URL or notification email-log reinterpretation is introduced. Target availability resolution remains with later owning-module public contracts.
The quality review covers architecture and source contracts; browser/HTTP execution and full historical migration-chain execution remain separate test evidence.
